content.query:
select 
p.patient_id, count(*) as count_claims
from 
silver.claimMain c 
left join silver.patientIdentifier p 
on c.patient_id_reference = p.patient_id

where c.year in (2020, 2021) 
and p.gender = 'male' 
    and datediff(year, p.birthDate, current_date()) between 18 and 25
group by p.patient_id
